
 # LLD.exe lib dependencies
 
 crt2.o
 libadvapi32.a
 libgcc.a
 libgcc_eh.a
 libkernel32.a
 libmingw32.a
 libmingwex.a
 libmoldname.a
 libshell32.a
 libucrt.a
 libuser32.a

 # LLD for Linux

 The lld executable for linux has been built from source in a linux environment and in a completely static way,
 so it has zero dependencies.
 The environment use was a docker container working inside the wsl.
